comment: HL7 UTG, SNOMED National Release Centres, and OpenHIE are useful references, but they represent different scopes and governance models. The text may imply that they can be combined straightforwardly into one national SGI.

anchor.note: p.61 l.Lines 477-485 read as the printed page; section 3.4.5 agrees

public.text: HL7 UTG, SNOMED National Release Centres, and OpenHIE are useful references, but they represent different scopes and governance models. The text may imply that they can be combined straightforwardly into one national SGI.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a comparison of their scope, authority, artefacts, licensing, participation model, and applicability. Clarify that countries must define how these external governance processes interact with national authority.
